Name: Variant Anime Portraits
Author: Bunnihime
Description:
With credits to Toonyoza's portraits here: http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14/?
A Variant of their original version with permission from original artist.

[How to Install]
> Download and extract file
> Copy .xnb File to Folder \Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits

[b]You SHOULD backup original portrait files before installing the mod[/b]

[center][u]UPDATES
[/u]If you are only downloading the LITE file for update, please replace the old files from the same folder.
